item.title: Michigan's Grosse Pointe parent's LGBTQ flag video led to school ban. Now he's suing
item.description: DETROIT — A Grosse Pointe Public School System parent has sued the district after it issued him a no-trespass order for posting a video on social media criticizing LGBTQ flags hung at the middle school in September 2024, arguing the district violated his free speech ...

item.title: Zoox robotaxis to roam in more San Francisco neighborhoods and cover new cities
item.description: LOS ANGELES — The Bay Area-based robotaxi company Zoox is trying to get ahead of the competition with a significant expansion in San Francisco and Las Vegas and plans to launch in Austin, Texas, and Miami.

item.title: 2 earthquakes reported hours apart in North Carolina community, USGS says
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. —Two shallow earthquakes were reported late Monday in Dillsboro, North Carolina, and hundreds of people have reported they felt the shaking, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.

item.title: New on DVD: Ping-pong through '50s NYC with 'Marty Supreme'
item.description: Josh Safdie's recent solo directorial outing, nominated for nine Oscars, tops the DVD releases for the week of March 31.

item.title: Why Amazon MGM Studios needed a 'Hail Mary'
item.description: LOS ANGELES — It was a big weekend for “Project Hail Mary” — and by extension, Amazon MGM Studios.

item.title: Blake Lively issues response to judge's ruling in Justin Baldoni case
item.description: Blake Lively insists that she is "grateful" for the judge's ruling despite having the majority of the allegations in her lawsuit against It Ends With Us co-star Justin Baldoni dismissed.

item.title: King Charles and Sir David Beckham team up to design Chelsea Flower Show garden
item.description: King Charles and Sir David Beckham have met at the monarch's Highgrove estate to finalise plans for a special garden that will be on display at next month's Chelsea Flower Show.

item.title: Two fires break out in Southern California amid Santa Ana winds, triggering evacuations
item.description: LOS ANGELES — A pair of brush fires erupted in Southern California on Friday afternoon, forcing evacuations in Los Angeles and Riverside counties as the first major blazes of the season after a winter of intense rains and periods of scorching heat.

item.title: 'Break down the door': 911 calls reveal relatives knew Coral Springs vice mayor was in danger
item.description: MIAMI — Relatives of the husband of murdered Coral Springs Vice Mayor Nancy Metayer Bowen knew she was in danger and urged police to break down the door of her home Wednesday afternoon to make sure she was alive, 911 calls released Friday show.

item.title: Judge orders end to Kalshi sports outcome contracts in Nevada
item.description: The prediction market operator that has been in a legal dispute with Nevada gaming regulators for more than a year on Friday was banned by a Carson City judge from writing contracts involving sports results with Nevada residents.

item.title: Don Lemon says he 'definitely' could be better president than Trump
item.description: Don Lemon sees no reason he can’t someday be elected to serve as the President of the United States.

item.title: Anchorage election officials push back on 'misleading' claims about its mobile voting system
item.description: ANCHORAGE, Alaska — A company that’s been touting Anchorage’s mobile voting use has been told to stop.

item.title: Trump directs rest of DHS staff to be paid as shutdown drags on
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump on Friday issued a memo ordering that the remaining Department of Homeland Security employees be paid during a record-long partial government shutdown affecting the agency.

item.title: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share video of them skiing with son Archie
item.description: Sharing a glimpse of family life as they pass on their love of skiing to their son Prince Archie, Meghan, Duchess of Sussex and Prince Harry have uploaded a video online showing the boy on the slopes.

item.title: Mel B declares any potential Spice Girls documentary must be 'honest'
item.description: When quizzed about the band getting back together, singer Mel B said any potential Spice Girls documentary must be "honest".
